records.title: FORM 10-Q

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Operating income in our Food Service segment increased $2,821,000 in the quarter to $9,001,000 primarily due to the increase in sales and improved product mix, as well as the benefits of expense leverage.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Sales to food service customers increased $51,307,000 or 32% in the first quarter to $211,732,000.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Handheld sales to retail supermarket customers decreased 54% in the quarter, driven by proactive discontinuations of margin dilutive products.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Operating income increased $14,267,000 or 2,468% for the quarter to $14,845,000.

records.title: 10-K TRACTOR SUPPLY
records.text: Over the past five years, we have experienced considerable growth in stores, growing from 1,738 stores at the end of fiscal 2016 to 2,181 stores (2,003 Tractor Supply and Del’s retail stores and 178 Petsense retail stores) at the end of fiscal 2021, and in net sales, with a compounded annual growth rate of approximately 13.4%.

records.title: 10-K TRACTOR SUPPLY
records.text: Comparable store sales increased 16.9% in fiscal 2021 versus a 23.1% increase in fiscal 2020.

records.title: 10-K TRACTOR SUPPLY
records.text: Our inventory and accounts payable levels typically build in the first and third fiscal quarters to support the higher sales volume of the spring and cold-weather selling seasons, respectively.

records.title: 10-K TRACTOR SUPPLY
records.text: Gross profit increased 19.0% to $4.48 billion in fiscal 2021 from $3.76 billion in fiscal 2020, and gross margin decreased 25 basis points to 35.2% of net sales in fiscal 2021 from 35.4% of net sales in fiscal 2020.

records.title: 10-K TRACTOR SUPPLY
records.text: Operating income increased 88 basis points to 10.3% of net sales in fiscal 2021 from 9.4% of net sales in fiscal 2020.
